pass_rule_text.A_current_stage_acquisition: every QUAL world LEARNED_A under the shared W_A, median nmse_A(W_A) <= 0.25; K1: every QUAL world LEARNED_s at every stage B, C, D
pass_rule_text.B_sequential_retention: K1: every QUAL world RETAINED_t_at_s for every stage s and earlier t (SEQUENCE_HELD everywhere)
pass_rule_text.C_no_catastrophic_forgetting: K1: no CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s in any QUAL world
pass_rule_text.D_joint_quality: K1: median over QUAL worlds of final_mean_nmse <= 0.25
pass_rule_text.E_single_joint_state: K1: at every stage one executor created from W_s answers all four experiences' held-out inputs; no task label reaches a query or a learning step (structural)
pass_rule_text.F_declared_state_causality: (i) state_removed SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of QUAL worlds and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 2 x K1's; (ii) reset challenge: RESET_DEGRADED in at least 75% of QUAL worlds and median reset_ratio >= 10, read at the C boundary only; (iii) no re-teaching: every reset record ends at C
pass_rule_text.G_no_external_answer_store: consolidation receives W and the current experience's inputs only (structural); persistent extra bytes identical after every stage; no row stored beyond the current learn call; queries read W only
pass_rule_text.H_deterministic_state: first QUAL world: the K1 pipeline twice in process and once in a clean process yields identical W and state digests and metrics at every stage
pass_rule_text.I_transplant_and_reset_behaviour: every QUAL world: full-state transplant at B continues bitwise (W and state digests at C and D) and restores the identical state digest; the clean-process transplant probe is bitwise; the W-only negative control is flagged UNCONSOLIDATED, has a different state digest, reproduces the reset branch bitwise at C and differs from the uninterrupted run
pass_rule_text.J_capacity_accounting: K1 and C1R report persistent extra bytes and analytic operations per stage; M1 reports stored-experience bytes; K1 persistent extra bytes = 28,552 at every stage
pass_rule_text.K_native_feasibility: K1: analytic hot-path extra operations per step <= 1.0 x G1's (82,944 at R = 64); analytic operations per consolidation <= 1e8; persistent extra state fixed at 28,552 bytes (H packed, a), independent of the number of experiences; no stored rows, targets or task labels; closed-form consolidation (no iterative loop, no fibre reconditioning, no retraction); no hidden external state
pass_rule_text.L_numerical_robustness: within the one QUAL execution, child processes recompute the decision record with OpenBLAS forced to the Prescott and the Haswell kernel (single thread); every field of the decision record must equal the primary run's

decision_record.definition: validity booleans; mechanics booleans; gates A-K; disposition; outcome; per QUAL world: K1 LEARNED_s, RETAINED_t_at_s, CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s, HELD_s, SEQUENCE_HELD; per QUAL world: state_removed SEQUENCE_HELD, RESET_DEGRADED, transplant bitwise, W-only control pass; counts: M0 SEQUENCE_HELD and LEARNED-at-every-stage, M1 SEQUENCE_HELD
decision_record.descriptive_not_compared: C1R rows, every float, every W or state digest, timings, medians: they decide nothing in R3 and need not be kernel-invariant
decision_record.principle: stated before data: numerical robustness covers every decision-bearing R3 quantity and nothing else; any K1 decision-bearing kernel sensitivity fails R3

pass_rule_text.disposition: MECHANICS_FAIL if any mechanics check fails. Else TASK_INVALID_UNDER_QUAL (OUTCOME_V) if any validity condition fails. Else RETENTION_SUPPORTED_UNDER_FROZEN_SYNTHETIC_REGIME (OUTCOME_A) if gates A-L all hold. Else PARTIAL_REDUCTION (OUTCOME_C) if K1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in more QUAL worlds than M0 and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse <= 0.5 x M0's. Else REPLAY_ONLY (OUTCOME_B) if M1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in every QUAL world. Else NO_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT (OUTCOME_D). DEV may end earlier as TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV or K1_STOPPED_ON_DEV (no freeze, no QUAL). Only OUTCOME_A permits the native milestone; anything else is NO_CANONICAL_PROMOTION and R3 stops. A failure is recorded as it is

qualifiers.CAPACITY_SCOPE: always: retention is claimed only for jointly realizable aliasing-conflict sequences of this family
qualifiers.EXCEEDS_R0_REFERENCE: K1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in more QUAL worlds than C1R, or in as many with a smaller median final_mean_nmse
qualifiers.R0_REFERENCE_ALSO_SUFFICIENT: C1R meets the K1 criteria of gates A (B, C, D stages), B, C and D

regime.note: the Cognitive R0 / Retention R0 v1 constants (d, N, initialization, rate, step budget, rows, teacher family) for comparability

task_parameters.basis: Q = q(R) of a 6 x 6 matrix of i.i.d. N(0, 1) from stream basis, with columns multiplied by the sign of the corresponding diagonal of R (Haar orthogonal); q1..q6 are its columns
task_parameters.hidden_gain_origin: INHERITED from closed R2 evidence: R2's control-only DEV task rule chose 2.0 (DEV record b9911cd4e7d0113923ef55470bf20dc6c3c3c41ae360dd6e5f3734edf1f1fd20) and R2 QUAL validity held at 2.0. R3 freezes it here; no grid, no search. R3 DEV re-certifies validity on fresh worlds with controls only and stops (TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV) if it fails; it never changes the gain
task_parameters.inputs: x = M_t z, z ~ N(0, input_scale^2 I_3) from streams inputs-<t>-<train|test>; input_scale fixed
task_parameters.mismatched_plane: [q4, q5, q6]; stream mismatch-<t> is still drawn by the world builder (inherited) but no R3 measurement uses it
task_parameters.name: aliased hidden ridges
properties: hidden ridge of each later experience vanishes on every earlier plane
every G1 entity update lies in the current plane
task_parameters.pte: base W0[:, :32]; tail entities 0.125 v b for the R0 PTE value sets (0, 4, 7, 11) and (1, 2, 9, 10), with b = cos(theta) q1 + sin(theta) q4 the aliased axis of B; identical S3 and a B step that reads the differing coordinate
task_parameters.role: PRIMARY_GATING (the only arm); inherited family, fresh worlds
task_parameters.teacher: T* = [r_A, g q4, g q5, g q6]; r_A = S z / |S z| with S = [q1 q2 q3] and z ~ N(0, I_3) from stream teacher-A; targets g*(x) = sum_j phi(x . t*_j)
task_parameters.witness: W* = [T* | 0] (dim x width): answers every experience exactly
